source.method: Visual inspection of original owner photo, including original-resolution view. No image modification or generated marking used.

identity.scope: Owner identifies this as the external PoE brick being measured for router A. Serial and Cisco orderable PWR PID are not established from this visible portion.

correspondence_to_session_labels.view: IMG_1319 cable mating face with latch at top; A/B/C above D/E/F. Label drawing places P4/P5/P6 above P1/P2/P3, consistent with cavity keying and reported 12 V groups.

interpretation.verified_from_label: A-D is the designated PoE output pair. All six pins have power/return assignments; no separate enable or ID contact is identified. Label names a separate -53.5 V return; do not assume it is tied to E/F or earth.
interpretation.expected_polarity_when_active: With black on D/P1 and red on A/P4, nominal -53.5 V. Reverse probes would give +53.5 V.
interpretation.observed_comparison: Owner reports A-D 0 V through supply power cycles and only decaying cross-contact voltages. Thus the specified PoE output has not appeared at the connector during the unloaded test. Earlier B/C-to-E/F readings are 12.3 V; post-cycle recheck pending.
interpretation.inference: PoE output circuit or cable/contact fault is a stronger suspect. Separate enable-pin speculation is unsupported by the complete labeled connector assignment. The label does not prove no-load/minimum-load behavior, so a definitive defective-supply diagnosis still requires applicable specifications or a proper loaded/known-good comparison.
interpretation.limits: This label does not establish electrical isolation, capacity under load, live router-side voltage, or compatibility with C8235-G2/prototype. Not a confirmed PWR-CC1-230WAC.

next: Obtain the already-requested post-cycle E-B steady-voltage recheck. No further A-D cycling or random pin probing needed. If 12 V remains normal, prioritize qualified supply/cable verification or a known-good supported supply comparison; do not force a PSU profile or jumper output pins.
